segment.source: I thought I told you to leave me alone.<end>
segment.target: I thought I told you to leave me alone.<end>

segment.source:
::The lone man notices you approach his camp and swiftly responds - by aiming his gun at your head. It takes him but a few moments to address you, and does so with a voice that seems rather calm and relaxed considering the tense situation at hand.::
Don't move, $(#buddy/girl). Don't even think about moving... or else you'll find yourself obliterated on the spot. Now, who are you and what are you doing in these caves?<end>
segment.target:
::The lone man notices you approach his camp and swiftly responds - by aiming his gun at your head. It takes him but a few moments to address you, and does so with a voice that seems rather calm and relaxed considering the tense situation at hand.::
Don't move, $(#buddy/girl). Don't even think about moving... or else you'll find yourself obliterated on the spot. Now, who are you and what are you doing in these caves?<end>

segment.source: Whoa, don't shoot, man! My name is $(context.player.Name), and I mean no harm.<end>
segment.target: Whoa, don't shoot, man! My name is $(context.player.Name), and I mean no harm.<end>

segment.source: $(context.player.Name). $(context.player.Name), as you may have already noticed, we are in the middle of a cave and you just happen to have... "stumbled" upon this little camp here. I'll be keeping my eyes on you and you better make sure I don't spot you doing anything funky, or else... just think of my introductory statement again and you'll know what'll happen.<end>
segment.target: $(context.player.Name). $(context.player.Name), as you may have already noticed, we are in the middle of a cave and you just happen to have... "stumbled" upon this little camp here. I'll be keeping my eyes on you and you better make sure I don't spot you doing anything funky, or else... just think of my introductory statement again and you'll know what'll happen.<end>

segment.source: Now tell me, what do you want?<end>
segment.target: Now tell me, what do you want?<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: What are you doing here all alone?<end>
segment.target: What are you doing here all alone?<end>

segment.source: Well, first of all, what I'm doing here is none of your business. But, alone I am... at least for the moment.<end>
segment.target: Well, first of all, what I'm doing here is none of your business. But, alone I am... at least for the moment.<end>

segment.source: Yet, you are here too, somehow. ::He makes a brief pause before continuing.:: By the way, did you happen to notice anyone else in these caves?<end>
segment.target: Yet, you are here too, somehow. ::He makes a brief pause before continuing.:: By the way, did you happen to notice anyone else in these caves?<end>

segment.source: As a matter of fact, yes, I have. I saw two men who were killed by rathounds not too far away from here.<end>
segment.target: As a matter of fact, yes, I have. I saw two men who were killed by rathounds not too far away from here.<end>

segment.source: So, that explains it. Look now: One of those men had a key that is very, very important to me. If you could get it for me, I'd be willing to pay fifty charons for it. Easy money.<end>
segment.target: So, that explains it. Look now: One of those men had a key that is very, very important to me. If you could get it for me, I'd be willing to pay fifty charons for it. Easy money.<end>

segment.source: Is this the key?<end>
segment.target: Is this the key?<end>

segment.source: Let me see. ::He takes a quick look.:: Yes... *yes* it is. I'll give you fifty charons for it.<end>
segment.target: Let me see. ::He takes a quick look.:: Yes... *yes* it is. I'll give you fifty charons for it.<end>

segment.source: Here it is. It was nice doing business with ya.<end>
segment.target: Here it is. It was nice doing business with ya.<end>

segment.source: ::He hands you the money and takes the key from you.:: Great, that's it. ::He pockets the key and looks at you with a satisfied smirk on his face.:: As for you, $(#buddy/girl), you better be on your way now. See you later... or not.<end>
segment.target: ::He hands you the money and takes the key from you.:: Great, that's it. ::He pockets the key and looks at you with a satisfied smirk on his face.:: As for you, $(#buddy/girl), you better be on your way now. See you later... or not.<end>

segment.source: ::[Mercantile]:: What? I had to risk my head for that key and that is all you can offer me? I want double.<end>
segment.target: ::[Mercantile]:: What? I had to risk my head for that key and that is all you can offer me? I want double.<end>

segment.source: Fine, I'll give you a hundred charons. Usually you would get a bullet between your eyes, but today... I feel a bit more merciful.<end>
segment.target: Fine, I'll give you a hundred charons. Usually you would get a bullet between your eyes, but today... I feel a bit more merciful.<end>

segment.source: Here you go. It was nice doing business with ya.<end>
segment.target: Here you go. It was nice doing business with ya.<end>

segment.source: Are you derailed? Don't barter with me unless you desire a bullet between your eyes. Choose - fifty charons or a bullet.<end>
segment.target: Are you derailed? Don't barter with me unless you desire a bullet between your eyes. Choose - fifty charons or a bullet.<end>

segment.source: Okay, okay, here's the key. My fifty charons, please.<end>
segment.target: Okay, okay, here's the key. My fifty charons, please.<end>

segment.source: Sorry, buddy, no deal. I'll be leaving now.<end>
segment.target: Sorry, buddy, no deal. I'll be leaving now.<end>

segment.source: ::His voice suddenly drops in pitch and becomes grittier, much tenser than it was previously.:: You've just made a big mistake, and you will pay for it. If you won't give me the key - I'll take it from you by force.<end>
segment.target: ::His voice suddenly drops in pitch and becomes grittier, much tenser than it was previously.:: You've just made a big mistake, and you will pay for it. If you won't give me the key - I'll take it from you by force.<end>

segment.source: ::Fight!::<end>
segment.target: ::Fight!::<end>

segment.source: On a second thought, I'll keep it for myself. See you around Milton.<end>
segment.target: On a second thought, I'll keep it for myself. See you around Milton.<end>

segment.source: Could use some money. It's a deal.<end>
segment.target: Could use some money. It's a deal.<end>

segment.source: Great, I'll be here... *waiting.*<end>
segment.target: Great, I'll be here... *waiting.*<end>

segment.source: I'm not going back there. Go get it yourself.<end>
segment.target: I'm not going back there. Go get it yourself.<end>

segment.source: ::He frowns, but says nothing otherwise.::<end>
segment.target: ::He frowns, but says nothing otherwise.::<end>

segment.source: Nope. Sorry, I'm just passing by.<end>
segment.target: Nope. Sorry, I'm just passing by.<end>

segment.source: Curses. Listen, I'm looking for two men in these caves - don't ask why. I need something from them, a small footlocker key. So, if you meet them, find their bodies or whatever... just get me that key. I'm even willing to pay for it; fifty charons, as a matter of fact.<end>
segment.target: Curses. Listen, I'm looking for two men in these caves - don't ask why. I need something from them, a small footlocker key. So, if you meet them, find their bodies or whatever... just get me that key. I'm even willing to pay for it; fifty charons, as a matter of fact.<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: Hey, I found that key you were looking for.<end>
segment.target: Hey, I found that key you were looking for.<end>

segment.source: Really? Give it to me; I promised charons and I have them right here. Just give me the key.<end>
segment.target: Really? Give it to me; I promised charons and I have them right here. Just give me the key.<end>

segment.source: Why do you need that key? Is it for that locker?<end>
segment.target: Why do you need that key? Is it for that locker?<end>

segment.source: None of your business, $(#buddy/girl).<end>
segment.target: None of your business, $(#buddy/girl).<end>

segment.source: Why are you looking for those men?<end>
segment.target: Why are you looking for those men?<end>

segment.source: I told you not to ask that. Are you deaf?<end>
segment.target: I told you not to ask that. Are you deaf?<end>

segment.source: Okay, I'll search for the key.<end>
segment.target: Okay, I'll search for the key.<end>

segment.source: I really don't care about your stupid key.<end>
segment.target: I really don't care about your stupid key.<end>

segment.source: ::He frowns, but otherwise says nothing.::<end>
segment.target: ::He frowns, but otherwise says nothing.::<end>

segment.source: About that key...<end>
segment.target: About that key...<end>

segment.source: Changed your mind, $(#buddy/girl)?<end>
segment.target: Changed your mind, $(#buddy/girl)?<end>

segment.source: I'll be going now.<end>
segment.target: I'll be going now.<end>

segment.source: Who I am is none of your concern. But, know that if I wanted to hurt you I would have done so already instead of participating in this staring contest.<end>
segment.target: Who I am is none of your concern. But, know that if I wanted to hurt you I would have done so already instead of participating in this staring contest.<end>

segment.source: That is good to know. As you may have already noticed, we are in the middle of a cave and you just happen to have... "stumbled" upon this little camp here. I'll be keeping my eyes on you and you better make sure I don't spot you doing anything funky, or else... just think of my introductory statement again and you'll know what'll happen.<end>
segment.target: That is good to know. As you may have already noticed, we are in the middle of a cave and you just happen to have... "stumbled" upon this little camp here. I'll be keeping my eyes on you and you better make sure I don't spot you doing anything funky, or else... just think of my introductory statement again and you'll know what'll happen.<end>

segment.source: ::[Intimidate]:: It is you who will be obliterated if you don't put that gun away right now, you dirty rat! Name's $(context.player.Name). Who the hell are YOU, and what are YOU doing here?<end>
segment.target: ::[Intimidate]:: It is you who will be obliterated if you don't put that gun away right now, you dirty rat! Name's $(context.player.Name). Who the hell are YOU, and what are YOU doing here?<end>

segment.source: ::You notice his voice tenses up for a split second, but then quickly reverts to its original quality.:: Look, ::He smiles:: there is no need for us to spill each other's guts here, right? We are, after all, both civilized $(#gentlemen/human beings). <end>
segment.target: ::You notice his voice tenses up for a split second, but then quickly reverts to its original quality.:: Look, ::He smiles:: there is no need for us to spill each other's guts here, right? We are, after all, both civilized $(#gentlemen/human beings). <end>

segment.source: ::Your words are met with a chuckle.:: You sure sound tough, kid. But I want to see how tough you really are.<end>
segment.target: ::Your words are met with a chuckle.:: You sure sound tough, kid. But I want to see how tough you really are.<end>

segment.source: ::Fight!::<end>
segment.target: ::Fight!::<end>

segment.source: I didn't know there was anyone in here. I'll just get going and leave you to whatever you were doing.<end>
segment.target: I didn't know there was anyone in here. I'll just get going and leave you to whatever you were doing.<end>

segment.source: That might be wise. ::He still keeps your head between crosshairs and waits for you to leave.::<end>
segment.target: That might be wise. ::He still keeps your head between crosshairs and waits for you to leave.::<end>

segment.source: ::Leave.::<end>
segment.target: ::Leave.::<end>

segment.source: ::Attack!::<end>
segment.target: ::Attack!::<end>

segment.source: What do I want? How about cutting your tongue out, worm! ::Fight!::<end>
segment.target: What do I want? How about cutting your tongue out, worm! ::Fight!::<end>

segment.source: What'll it be?<end>
segment.target: What'll it be?<end>
